description: Implementation of ue_security_manager class handling security context, algorithms, and keys for UE security in a 3GPP-based system.

classes.name: ue_security_manager
classes.description: Manages UE security context, algorithms, and keys for 3GPP systems.

methods.name: is_security_context_initialized
methods.description: Checks if the security context has been initialized with selected algorithms.

methods.name: get_up_as_config
methods.description: Retrieves the security configuration for the 'up' domain.

methods.name: get_up_128_as_config
methods.description: Retrieves 128-bit security configuration for the 'up' domain.

methods.name: get_ncc
methods.description: Returns the NCC value from the security context.

methods.name: init_security_context
methods.description: Initializes security context and selects algorithms based on preferences.

methods.name: perform_horizontal_key_derivation
methods.description: Performs horizontal key derivation for given PCI and SSB ARFCN.
